newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican Energy completes asset sale.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican Energy completes asset sale.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Holdings Co said Friday it completed the sale of its InterCoast Oil and Gas Co, GED Energy Services Inc and InterCoast Gas Services Co to KCS Energy Inc of Edison, N.J.

As agreed on November 15, 1996, MidAmerican received about $210 million in cash and 435,000 warrants to purchase KCS common stock. The warrants have a four-year term and exercise price of $45 per share.
MidAmerican Energy, a utility holding company, has three subsidiaries: MidAmerican Energy Co, MidAmerican Capital Co and Midwest Capital Group.
